items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He used a different name for Brand. What did he call him? His name was Wallman

ctx.x: Just like we were coming here and Zutty had a job. Because Zutty said we'll go right to Brand and I'll borrow some money from him. He'll give us a place to stay. We'll stay with him.
He used a different name for Brand. What did he call him? His name was Wallman
